Schmarrn

A tiny Markdown CMS. Pages are plain index.md files in a content tree; the PHP core stores and serves them and never parses Markdown (bridge/store.php:6). One renderer — mdms / renderMdms (src/lib/render.ts) — turns Markdown into HTML, for the live site and for these pages alike.

These pages are the bakery, baked

Same theme as the live CMS — the bakery layout (bridge/templates/bakery/page.html) — but baked to static HTML for GitHub Pages.

Not live: GitHub Pages runs no PHP, so no bridge/serve.php, no session, no editor. The bake (scripts/bake-docs.ts, npm run build:docs) renders docs/content/*.md through renderMdms, fills the bakery template with a docs nav, copies theme.css, menu.js and the noto fonts into docs/build/assets/, and writes one .html per page.

The CMS content tree (src/content/) is untouched by this bake.

The docs

Links point at the baked .html siblings — the bake emits HTML, so .md targets would 404 on Pages. Sources: module-cookbook.md, theme-contract.md, api-shape.md in docs/content/.

  • Module Cookbook — module-cookbook.md — the closed module set and its injection wall
  • Theme Contract — theme-contract.md — what a theme may assume
  • API Shape — api-shape.md — the API doors and their refusals

Why static

The docs are read far more than they are written; a static bake needs no server, no PHP, no database. The live CMS keeps the editing; the bake keeps the reading.
